drifted.spec_text: Performance-sensitive paths (IO submission, batch processing, qpair selection) MUST have benchmarks
drifted.actual: No benches/ directory in block-device-spdk-nvme crate. QueuePairPool is pub with unit tests. apps/iops-benchmark measures aggregate performance but not per-function overhead.

drifted.spec_text: FR-004 specifies async IO submission; FR-015 specifies queue pair exploitation. Neither addresses behavior when spdk_nvme_ns_cmd_read/write returns ENOMEM.
drifted.actual: When rc == ENOMEM (-12), actor enters a spin-retry loop for up to 1ms (TscClock). On each retry, all queue pairs are polled via process_completions(0) to drain completions and free slots. If deadline expires with rc still non-zero, context is reclaimed, pending_ops entry removed, and error completion sent to client.
drifted.suggested_text: When spdk_nvme_ns_cmd_read or spdk_nvme_ns_cmd_write returns ENOMEM (-12), the actor MUST retry the submission for up to 1ms (measured by TscClock). On each retry, the actor MUST poll all queue pairs for completions. If the 1ms deadline expires without successful submission, the operation MUST fail with an error completion; pending_ops entry and context pool slot MUST be reclaimed.

drifted.spec_text: The component MUST exploit different NVMe IO queues with varying queue depths to minimize latency for a given batch size.
drifted.actual: STANDARD_DEPTHS = [4, 16, 64, 256]. select_index chooses shallowest queue with available() >= batch_size; falls back to deepest. io_queue_requests = depth * 2. CONTEXT_POOL_CAPACITY = 340 (sum of standard depths).
drifted.note: Under-specification rather than conflict. Depth values, shallowest-fit algorithm, fallback-to-deepest, and 2x request pool sizing are unconstrained by spec.

unspecced.feature: ENOMEM retry loop with 1ms TSC deadline and all-qpair poll on each attempt
